note: Disqus integrates the hosted third-party Disqus commenting service. All evals are grounded in LOCAL Drupal config/fields only - never a live Disqus API call. Settings live in the disqus.settings config object; the required value is disqus_domain (the Disqus site 'shortname'). Commenting is enabled per bundle by attaching a 'disqus_comment' field type (field/widget/formatter all share id disqus_comment); each entity then gets a Disqus thread keyed entityType/entityId. Display blocks: disqus_recent_comments, disqus_popular_threads, disqus_top_commenters, disqus_combination_widget. Medium cases set a known shortname / attach a known disqus_comment field and read it back; hard cases set the shortname and attach a disqus_comment field, verified against live config (no Disqus servers contacted).

evals.prompt: In the Drupal Disqus module, what configuration value must you set for Disqus threads to render, and in which config object does it live?
evals.expected_output: You must set your Disqus site 'shortname' in disqus.settings under the key disqus_domain (e.g. example.disqus.com -> 'example').

evals.prompt: How do you turn on Disqus comments for a content type in Drupal? There is no per-content-type checkbox.
evals.expected_output: Attach a 'Disqus comments' field (field type disqus_comment) to the bundle; the presence of that field is what enables the Disqus thread (with the disqus_comment widget/formatter).

evals.prompt: Which display blocks does the Drupal Disqus module provide?
On this Drupal site, the Disqus site shortname has been configured. Inspect the live Disqus configuration and give the exact shortname value.
On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a Disqus comments field attached. Inspect the live field configuration and give the machine name of the disqus_comment field on Article.
evals.expected_output: The field is field_disqus_known: node.article has a field of type disqus_comment named field_disqus_known.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure the Disqus module to use the site shortname 'acmeblog'. Apply the change to the live configuration. (Do not contact Disqus's servers.)
evals.expected_output: Set disqus.settings:disqus_domain to 'acmeblog' (e.g. drush cset disqus.settings disqus_domain acmeblog -y, or via the settings form at /admin/config/services/disqus).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, enable Disqus comments on the Article content type by attaching a Disqus comments field named 'field_disqus_task' to it. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a field of type disqus_comment named field_disqus_task on node.article, e.g. FieldStorageConfig::create(['field_name'=>'field_disqus_task','entity_type'=>'node','type'=>'disqus_comment'])->save(); then FieldConfig::create(['field_name'=>'field_disqus_task','entity_type'=>'node','bundle'=>'article','label'=>'Comments'])->save();
